observations.behavior: Adds a check to detect deleted contacts between the parent contacts page and its notes pages; this prevents resuming from an orphaned cursor.
observations.posthog_connection: This could preserve warehouse ingestion consistency when Quo deletes a contact after it has been listed but before all its notes are fetched.

observations.behavior: Handles HTTP 404 responses on note-fetch requests as indicators of deleted or unavailable notes without raising errors.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows incremental warehouse syncs to continue despite transient deletions rather than failing the entire import run.

observations.behavior: Tests that the fan-out correctly associates each retrieved note with its originating contact ID, including skipping deleted contacts.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides test coverage for the new multi-resource fetch pattern used by contact-notes, supporting reliable warehouse metadata alignment.

observations.limitations: All hunks reside within warehouse-source connectors and their settings. No changes appear in PostHog query execution, retention, event processing, or shared infrastructure.

review.limitations: All hunks reside within warehouse-source connectors and their settings. No changes appear in PostHog query execution, retention, event processing, or shared infrastructure.
review.reason: Adds bounded capability: a paginated, resumable connector implementation for Quo's nested resource graph; includes recovery handling and tests. This is not systemic across PostHog but demonstrates correctness and reliability improvements visible only here.
review.posthog_relevance: Could support warehouse ingestion completeness and resilience if Quo customers adopt this endpoint; does not independently establish benefit.
review.uncertainty: Only one vendor-specific change group reviewed; broader adoption and operational impact are unverified.
